mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 75 degrees with clear skies over Verona Community Park and the moon is in its first quarter phase.

City news today includes a reminder that vehicle parking in residential districts requires off-street, impervious surfaces, and residents are encouraged to use the Badger Prairie food scrap drop-off site for composting organic waste.
Coming up, we have trivia at Hop Haus and Lake Louie this Tuesday, followed by the Downtown Farmers Market, yoga at Insight Wellness, and trivia at The Bogey Factory this Wednesday.
In our weekly report, on July 14, officers performed a traffic stop that led to the seizure of marijuana and a firearm from a vehicle.
Today's flavor is Chocolate Caramel Twist, but since they are currently closed, you can look forward to stopping by when they open at 10:00 AM. Tomorrow's flavor will be Mint Explosion.
